description: Different model profiles should preserve Kotlin/JVM plan actions, Gradle verification, and DTO deferral.

lockedFields.reason: Kotlin/JVM plans must preserve the repo-native Gradle test command.

The DTO-style data class should remain deferred from direct testing.

The adapter must preserve matching Kotlin test evidence.
